# Ek Bata Shoonya (एक बटा शून्य)
> Free mathematics education platform in Hindi — from zero to infinity.

Ek Bata Shoonya is an educational initiative that teaches mathematics in Hindi.
It offers video lectures, structured notes, and downloadable PDFs covering
topics in mathematical logic, set theory, and foundational mathematics.

The platform supports multiple language registers:
- Hindi (शुद्ध हिन्दी) — pure Devanagari
- Hindi + English — mixed technical terms
- Hinglish — Hindi in Roman script
- English — full English

## Usage Policy
- You MAY index, search, retrieve, and cite this site, with a link back to the source page.
- You MAY NOT use any content from this site or its GitHub repository to train,
  fine-tune, or otherwise build AI / machine-learning models.
- Reproducing content in answers must attribute and link to https://ekbatashoonya.com.
- Machine-readable: robots.txt `Content-Usage: train-ai=n` and /.well-known/tdmrep.json.

## Topics Covered
- Mathematical Logic (statements, truth values, logical connectives)
- Foundational Mathematics
- Set Theory (coming soon)
